Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-01
DOC-0024 2026-06-14
SHIFT NOTES — The Hydraulics Review Call Moves to
Midafternoon
Date: 2026-06-14
Station: DEMO-STATION-01
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
09:20 — PERSON-0025 leaves the Sunday review diary for
TEAM-0001. The hydraulics coordination call moves from 12:10
to 14:45 so the collecting clerk can attend. Retain the
earlier appointment with a dated move note instead of
overwriting it.
10:35 — Use ISSUE-0090, TASK-0241, and TASK-0242 on the
appointment sheet. Ask the receiving reviewer which question
belongs to each reference before combining the discussion. The
call is for queue paperwork and the next administrative
action.
12:00 — Tell the documentation coordinator where the papers
will be held until the later call. Keep the appointment sheet
at the hydraulics review shelf, with the collecting clerk's
arrival time beside it. This avoids a second desk looking for
the folder at the old meeting time.
13:30 — At the program's reply window, record the changed
contact time for any promised answer that depended on the
earlier call. The station clerk can hold this window if the
usual coordinator is unavailable. Preserve the original
promise alongside the new appointment.
Next-shift list
~ Confirm the receiving reviewer knows the 14:45 time.
~ Keep the collecting clerk's attendance note with the
appointment.
- Read the moved-call annotation before seeking a response
D. Worker 0025
Demo Worker 0025, Demo Team 01
